installApp.title: Install the app on your phone
installApp.text: An icon will appear on your home screen. Your report will open in one tap, with no browser address bar.
installApp.inAppBrowserHint: Opened this from Telegram, WhatsApp or another app? Open it in Safari first — installing won’t work from inside the app.

step1.text: Tap the ‘…’ button to the right of the Safari address bar.
step1.imageAlt: Safari address bar with the ‘…’ button on the right, circled in red

step2.text: In the menu that opens, tap Share.
step2.imageAlt: Safari menu with the Share option highlighted by a red box and arrow

step3.text: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
step3.imageAlt: Share menu scrolled down, with Add to Home Screen circled in red

step4.text: Check the name and address, then tap Add in the top-right corner.
step4.imageAlt: Add to Home Screen dialog showing the name MinistryApp, the address jw.fenko.dev, and the Add button

step5.text: Done. The icon is now on your home screen. Open the app from there.
step5.imageAlt: iPhone home screen with the MinistryApp icon circled in red

hero.title: MinistryApp
hero.text: A personal record of your ministry: hours, Bible studies, and goals for the month and the service year.

day.title: Day
day.text: Log ministry hours and Bible studies for a chosen day, in 15-minute steps. Shows progress for the month and the service year.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: A month grid marking the days you reported. Pick a day to open its hours and studies.

month.title: Month
month.text: A day-by-day summary for the month: hours and studies in a list, compared against the goal, with the month closed off into the year.

year.title: Year
year.text: The service year (September to August), month by month: hours, deviation from the goal, and switching between years.

profile.title: Profile
profile.text: Your type of service and goal, personal monthly and yearly targets, pace status, and access to the beyond-the-goal screen.

paceDeviation.title: Pace deviation
paceDeviation.text: Every day and month is measured against the share of the goal expected by that date — green when you are ahead, terracotta when you are behind.

personalGoals.title: Personal goals
personalGoals.text: The standard hours come from your type of service; you can set your own monthly and yearly goal instead, from a preset or by hand.

beyondGoal.title: Beyond the goal
beyondGoal.text: Once the year's goal is met, a separate screen shows how many hours you are over, and in which months.

accountSignIn.title: Account sign-in
accountSignIn.text: Accounts are issued by the administrator — write to <mail>admin@jw.fenko.dev</mail> if you need one. No registration required; your report syncs across devices.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.text: Encrypted in transit and at rest, and never passed to third parties. Only you and the super administrator can read it — not to check up on you, but so an entry can be corrected or deleted at your request.
